repos.name: orbital-insight
repos.description: See which satellites cross your sky tonight, find out what that moving light was, and explore every active satellite on a live globe. Real orbits, computed in your browser.
repos.summary: Open the site · How the numbers are made · Notes from building it
features: See what's up tonight. Type a town (or share your location) and get the passes you can actually see: only ones where the satellite is sunlit against a dark sky. Each comes with a little chart of your sky, the direction…
Identify a sighting. Saw a steady light glide past? Say when and which way you were looking, and the whole catalog is checked against your sky for that moment.
Explore the globe. About 16,000 objects, propagated live. Follow the ISS, scrub time forward, click any dot.
See who's in orbit. Every satellite by orbit height and tilt, where Starlink's shells, the sun-synchronous band and the geostationary ring jump out.
Screen for close approaches. Pick a satellite and check it against everything else for the next few days.
repos.built: Every satellite in orbit has a published set of numbers describing its orbit, refreshed every day or so by the people who track them. Feed those numbers into SGP4, the standard model the tracking community uses, and you get where the satellite is at any moment. This site does that in your browser for about 16,000 satellites at once, which is what puts the whole sky on the globe and lets it check a sighting against…

repos.name: powerflow
repos.description: Paper-trade the Texas power grid on real ERCOT prices: bid tomorrow's auction, watch real time, settle on ERCOT's calendar.
repos.summary: ERCOT prices every hour of Texas electricity twice. The day-ahead market clears an auction for tomorrow, today. The real-time market prices the same hour again as it is delivered. A cold snap, a plant trip or a windy night pulls the two apart.
features: You bid blind, as ERCOT requires. Bids close at 10:00 Central the day before and fill at the clearing price ERCOT publishes that afternoon.
You settle on ERCOT's calendar. Positions are marked to real time as each hour runs and settle when ERCOT calls the prices final, two business days later.
The prices are real. They come from ERCOT's public market reports every 15 minutes. Only the money is simulated.

gallery.alt: The HB_NORTH market: the day-ahead curve against real time, and the day-ahead bid ticket
Positions: a risk ladder of net MWh by delivery hour, and each position marked to real time with its settlement deadline
Analytics after settlement: equity, return, realized P&L, win rate, best and worst trade, drawdown

repos.name: Financial-Market-Volatility-Correlation-Analysis
repos.summary: An end-to-end quantitative risk system for a 113-asset cross-asset universe stocks, equity ETFs,
features: Fetches live market data from Yahoo Finance over a long history (default window: 2010-01-01 -> today) with a committed snapshot fallback (data/price_history.csv), so everything also works offline.

Calculates advanced risk & return metrics annualized (CAGR) returns, annualized volatility, Sharpe and Sortino ratios, maximum drawdown, Calmar ratio, historical VaR/CVaR (95% & 99%), skewness, excess kurtosis, beta,…

Benchmark-relative analytics tracking error, information ratio and up/down capture ratios to separate skill from market exposure, plus calendar-year return tables and the largest drawdown episodes (peak -> trough ->…
Builds correlation matrices to study co-movement, plus rolling correlation and rolling volatility for any pair of assets.
Optimizes portfolios maximum-Sharpe (tangency) portfolio, global minimum-variance portfolio, a Markowitz efficient frontier, and 10,000 Monte Carlo portfolios for context, all long-only via SLSQP.
repos.built: The analytics live in a small package; every entry point is a thin presenter on top of it.
